notes: Bibliographic identity only: no passage witness is pinned. The Latin text is public domain (the Wadding edition, Lyon 1639, vol. 4), but no immutable transcription has been found; the critical edition is in copyright. Do not cite claims from it until a witness is pinned. It stands for Scotus' defence of self-motion (IX q.14: a thing can be virtually in act and formally in potency with respect to the same perfection).
